## Definition of Done

- [ ] Does what the step says, demonstrated rather than assumed
- [ ] Tests added and passing, and proven able to fail
- [ ] Format, lint, types and boundaries clean
- [ ] Security gates green; threat check done; no secrets
- [ ] Logs, error tracking and audit events added where relevant
- [ ] Rechecked: diff re-read, independent review done, findings fixed
- [ ] No TODOs, skipped tests, dead code or unused dependencies
